name: Encounter
summary: Four new German reserve corps strike the Allied cavalry screen. Roulers falls and the British 7th Division gives up its advance on Menin.

name: Ridge lost
summary: The Germans take Passchendaele and Becelaere. The British I Corps arrives behind Ypres.

name: I Corps halted
summary: Haig's attack towards Poelcappelle and Langemarck is stopped in the afternoon; the French cavalry withdraws behind the canal.

name: Langemarck
summary: The Germans break in at Kortekeer Cabaret on the 22nd; the British retake it on the 23rd. Mass attacks on Langemarck fail.

name: French take over
summary: The French IX Corps and Territorials relieve the British 2nd and 1st Divisions in the north. The Germans cross the Yser at Tervaete.

name: Kruiseik lost
summary: German cavalry and the XXVII Reserve Corps take Kruiseik from the 7th Division.

name: Cross-roads lost
summary: A dawn attack in fog takes the cross-roads south-east of Gheluvelt. Army Group Fabeck assembles behind the cavalry.

name: Fabeck attacks
summary: Zandvoorde and Hollebeke fall to the new army group. The Belgians flood the Yser plain and the Germans there withdraw that night.

name: Gheluvelt
summary: Gheluvelt falls about 1.30 p.m.; the 2nd Worcestershire retake it and the line is re-formed in front of Veldhoek. Messines is stormed.

name: Messines ridge lost
summary: Messines and Wytschaete pass to the Germans. The French XVI Corps takes over west of the ridge.

name: 7th Division relieved
summary: Brigades of II Corps take over south of the Menin road. On the 6th the Germans take Klein Zillebeke and are checked at Zwarteleen.

name: Dixmude and St. Eloi
summary: Dixmude falls, the Germans reach the canal north of Ypres, and the Bavarians take St. Eloi.

name: Nonne Bosschen
summary: The Prussian Guard breaks through north of the Menin road, reaches Nonne Bosschen and is driven out.

name: Offensive called off
summary: A last attack south of the Menin road fails and the Fourth Army gives up the offensive.

name: End (British date)
summary: The French have taken over the salient from the British I Corps. The British official history ends the battle here.
